summary: Describes three variable scopes: global (config, env, CLI), play (vars, vars_files, vars_prompt, role defaults/vars), and host (inventory, include_vars, facts, registered output). Templates see all host-scoped variables plus facts and magic variables.
questions: What variable scopes does Ansible have?
Which variables can I use in a template?

answer_card.title: Variable scopes
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Global**: config, environment variables, command line
- **Play**: `vars`, `vars_files`, `vars_prompt`, role defaults and vars
- **Host**: inventory, `include_vars`, facts, registered output

Templates can use every variable in scope for the host, plus registered variables, facts and magic variables.
